She so rarely allowed Lucius to get her gifts but he had been so insistent that she shut up and let him do something nice for at least one birthday that she’d started to feel rather churlish denying him. 
当她解开丝带时，她的心跳得相当快，一种奇怪的渴望使她的手颤抖起来。她很少让卢修斯拿她的礼物，但他一直如此坚持，以至于她闭嘴，让他至少在一个生日里做点好事，以至于她开始觉得拒绝他相当粗鲁。

赫敏小心翼翼地剥开绿色的纸，在下面发现了柔软的深红色皮革。出于好奇，她撕掉了纸的其余部分，当卢修斯的礼物完全暴露在她面前时，她发出了一声喘息的“哦”。

“这是一本书？”乔治问道，听起来有些失望。

她的鼻子一阵刺痛，可能还有一条金色的飞贼卡在她的喉咙里，她把书拿在手里，从各个角度欣赏它。

它装订得很漂亮，深红色的皮革被明亮的金色缝线和镀金边缘所抵消。赫敏盯着书脊，发现里面嵌着一颗大红宝石。她没有理会所有看着她的人，翻开封面，当她发现卢修斯俯冲的笔迹在等着她时，她露出了笑容。

I persuaded Catherine to send me an additional final proof so I could have it specially bound , his note read. And I was perfectly polite, before you start fretting. If you’re going to go to the trouble of writing a book, then you should get it first and it should look better than every other edition. Happy Birthday, Hermione. I’ll see you tonight.  
我说服凯瑟琳给我寄了一份额外的最终校样，这样我就可以特别装订它了，他的便条上写着。 在你开始烦恼之前，我非常有礼貌。如果你要费心写一本书，那么你应该先买它，它应该比其他所有版本看起来都好。生日快乐，赫敏。今晚见。

一阵震惊的停顿，几个人啪地喝着饮料，罗恩被他的巧克力青蛙呛住了。然后金妮发出一声尖叫的笑声，她的头向后仰，双手平放在现在的桌子上。

Hermione fondly surveyed the pub populated by her increasingly inebriated friends, her attention lingering on the table where Harry, Neville, Draco and Ron were having a loud, drunken, but seemingly good-natured argument about Quidditch. 
赫敏深情地打量着酒吧里挤满了她越来越醉的朋友们，她的注意力在桌子上徘徊，哈利、纳威、德拉科和罗恩正在大声地、喝醉了，但似乎是善意地争论着魁地奇。

Sidling up to Ginny, Hermione laid a hand on her back and guided her away from Katie and Parvati with an apologetic smile. “Ginny,” she said quietly, “look, I have my dinner with Lucius in half an hour. If you don’t mind, I’m just going to slip away.”
赫敏侧身走到金妮身边，把手放在她的背上，带着歉意的微笑引导她离开凯蒂和帕瓦蒂。“金妮，”她轻声说，“你看，我半小时后就要和卢修斯一起吃晚饭了。如果你不介意的话，我就溜走了。

“Don’t you want to say goodbye?” Ginny asked, turning towards the room like she was about to holler into it. “I can –”
“你不想说再见吗？”金妮问道，转身朝房间走去，仿佛要对着房间大喊大叫。“我可以——”

“No!” Hermione grabbed her. “No. Er…if Draco knows I’m going then he’ll come with me and…” Hermione’s eyes drifted back over to the table where he was laughing. “He doesn’t get to do this very often.”
“不！”赫敏抓住了她。“不。的。。。如果德拉科知道我要走，那他就会跟我走，然后......”赫敏的眼睛又飘回到他正在笑的桌子上。“他不经常这样做。”

And he didn’t. She knew Draco had primarily remained in the manor to be there for his father but she rather suspected that he liked that it was a ready-made excuse for him to withdraw as well. When she’d seen all the self-disgust and regret he harboured during their interviews, Hermione had thought him a man who wasn't quite ready to face the world.
但他没有。她知道德拉科留在庄园里主要是为了陪他的父亲，但她更怀疑他喜欢这样一个现成的借口，让他也退出。当她看到他在采访中隐藏的所有自我厌恶和遗憾时，赫敏认为他是一个还没有准备好面对世界的人。

But Lucius wasn’t going to be locked up forever. 
但卢修斯不会永远被关起来。

Pretty soon, hopefully, the doors of the manor would be thrown open and Hermione didn’t think it would do Draco, Astoria or Scorpius too much harm to have a few more friendly faces looking in on them when it happened. 
希望很快，庄园的门就会被打开，赫敏认为当事情发生时，让一些更友好的面孔看着他们不会对德拉科、阿斯托利亚或斯科皮造成太大的伤害。

Following Hermione’s gaze, Ginny wrapped an arm around her waist and planted a wet kiss on her cheek. “You really are his mother,” she teased. 
顺着赫敏的目光，金妮用一只胳膊搂住她的腰，在她的脸颊上湿漉漉的吻。“你真的是他的妈妈，”她调侃道。

“Oh, shut up –” Hermione squirmed, trying to extract herself from Ginny who just held her tighter, pressing their hips together and laughing aloud. 
“哦，闭嘴——”赫敏扭动着身体，试图把自己从金妮身上抽离出来，金妮只是把她抱得更紧了，把他们的臀部压在一起，大声地笑着。

“I’m kidding ,” she said, her laughter dying down and ending with a high-pitched hiccup. “I’m kidding. We’ll look after him, I promise.”
“我在开玩笑，”她说，她的笑声逐渐平息，以一个尖锐的打嗝结束。“我在开玩笑。我们会照顾他的，我保证。

“Thank you.” Hermione kissed Ginny on the cheek and looked towards her small mound of presents in the corner. “Would you –”
“谢谢你。”赫敏亲吻了金妮的脸颊，看向角落里她那一小堆礼物。“你会——”

“We’ll make sure they get to your flat. I take it you’ve got –” Ginny leaned forward to look down and got the answer she was looking for when she saw Lucius’ gift still clutched tightly in Hermione’s right hand. She hadn’t put it down for the entire day. “It’s a good gift,” Ginny added softly, almost wonderingly, as she continued to stare at it. 
“我们会确保他们到达你的公寓。我认为你有——“金妮向前倾身低头，当她看到卢修斯的礼物仍然紧紧地攥在赫敏的右手里时，她得到了她正在寻找的答案。她一整天都没放下。“这是个不错的礼物，”金妮轻声补充道，几乎是疑惑地补充道，同时她继续盯着它看。

“Thank you for organising all of this.”
“感谢你们组织这一切。”

Ginny blinked, slowly dragging her eyes from the book to Hermione’s grateful face. “Of course," she said, shrugging a shoulder modestly. “Just remember what I said – my birthday. Push Harry towards something fun . I’m thinking a day at one of those Muggle places with the rollycoasters or whatever they’re called.”
金妮眨了眨眼，慢慢地将目光从书上移到赫敏感激的脸上。“当然，”她说，谦虚地耸了耸肩。“记住我说的话——我的生日。推动哈利走向有趣的事情。我在想在那些麻瓜地方呆一天，那里有 rollycoasters 或者他们叫什么东西。

Hermione could not see Harry being easily pushed towards that, especially if George would be joining them, but she said “I’ll try” anyway, receiving a firm nod from Ginny which distinctly said “you’d better.” Standing side-by-side, they looked out across the pub together for a moment, arms hooked around one another’s waists.
赫敏看不出哈利会被轻易地推向那个方向，特别是如果乔治会加入他们的话，但她还是说“我会努力的”，金妮坚定地点头，明确地说“你最好”。他们并排站着，一起望着酒吧的另一边，手臂搂着彼此的腰。

“It’s a shame you won’t be here to help when Ron inevitably tries to march up to Hogwarts to prostrate himself at Hannah’s feet.” Ginny dropped her head onto Hermione’s shoulder, her eyes fixed on her brother who had just leaped to his feet to demonstrate a recent save made by the Chudley Cannons’ keeper. “I think it’s going to take all of us.”
“很遗憾，当罗恩不可避免地试图走到霍格沃茨，匍匐在汉娜的脚下时，你不会在这里帮忙。”金妮把头靠在赫敏的肩膀上，眼睛盯着她的哥哥，他刚刚跳起来演示查德利大炮队的守门员最近做出的扑救。“我认为这需要我们所有人的努力。”

When Hermione quietly pushed her way into Lucius’ study just a few minutes before 7pm, she found him sitting on his sofa with his head bent, murmuring to himself. Frowning, she crept across the room and leaned over the sofa, discovering that he had Scorpius curled up into his chest and a book balanced in his lap. 
当赫敏在晚上 7 点前几分钟悄悄地推门进入卢修斯的书房时，她发现他坐在沙发上，低着头，喃喃自语。她皱着眉头，蹑手蹑脚地穿过房间，靠在沙发上，发现他把斯科皮蜷缩在胸前，腿上放着一本书。

When Hermione’s shadow appeared on the pages of the book, both Lucius and Scorpius glanced up at her, a pleased smile spreading across the former’s face while the latter merely blinked at her, his eyes heavy and tired.
当赫敏的影子出现在书页上时，卢修斯和斯科皮都抬头看了她一眼，前者的脸上露出满意的笑容，而后者只是朝她眨了眨眼，眼神沉重而疲惫。

“Hermione,” Lucius greeted, keeping his voice low and peaceful so as not to disturb Scorpius. 
“赫敏，”卢修斯打招呼，压低声音，尽量平和，以免打扰斯科皮。

Hermione pressed a lingering kiss to Lucius’ cheek before moving around to the front of the sofa to take a seat alongside him. As she lowered herself onto the seat, Scorpius shyly buried his face into Lucius, clutching his toy lion tightly to his chest. 
赫敏在卢修斯的脸颊上亲了一下，然后走到沙发前面，在他身边坐下。当她把自己放到座位上时，斯科皮害羞地把脸埋进卢修斯的脸里，把他的玩具狮子紧紧地攥在胸前。

“How was the party?” Lucius asked, comfortingly tightening the arm curled around Scorpius.
“派对怎么样？”卢修斯问道，安慰地收紧了蜷缩在斯科皮身上的手臂。

“Increasingly drunken,” Hermione said on a sigh. “But wonderful.”
“越来越醉了，”赫敏叹了口气说。“但太棒了。”

“Astoria was growing tired, so I offered to take Scorpius off her hands until his bedtime. I had rather thought that Draco might come back with you to do it himself,” Lucius said, glancing around like his son might choose that moment to waltz through the door. 
“阿斯托利亚越来越累了，所以我提议把斯科皮从她的手上拿走，直到他睡觉。我宁愿想德拉科可能会和你一起回来亲自做这件事，“卢修斯说，环顾四周，仿佛他的儿子可能会选择那个时刻跳华尔兹进门。

“I sort of…snuck off without him,” Hermione admitted, feeling a stab of guilt when she saw concern flash across Lucius’ face. “He was having a nice time! I thought he should stay. Make some friends.”
“我有点......没有他就偷偷溜走了，“赫敏承认道，当她看到卢修斯脸上闪过担忧时，她感到一阵内疚。“他玩得很开心！我认为他应该留下来。交一些朋友。

“While I’m sure that’s very kind of you,” Lucius said, closing Scorpius’ book and placing it on the sofa between them, “it does mean we have an additional guest for your birthday dinner.”
“虽然我确定你很好，”卢修斯说，合上斯科皮的书，把它放在他们之间的沙发上，“这确实意味着我们的生日晚宴多了一位客人。

Hermione smiled warmly at Scorpius, who lifted his face away from Lucius’ chest to yawn, his deep inhale and heavy exhale ruffling the wispy threads that made up his lion’s mane. “I think we can wait until after his bedtime. Based on that yawn, I’d say it’s not far away at all”
赫敏对斯科皮温暖地笑了笑，斯科皮把脸从卢修斯的胸前抬起，打了个哈欠，他深吸一口气和沉重的呼气搅乱了构成他狮子鬃毛的细丝。“我想我们可以等到他睡觉后再说。根据那个哈欠，我想说它一点也不远。

Eyes returning to Lucius, Hermione's smile faded and she tilted her head. "Your hair is tied back," she observed, finally honing in on what looked different about him. 
目光回到卢修斯身上，赫敏的笑容消失了，她歪了歪头。“你的头发扎在后面，”她观察着，终于磨练出他看起来有什么不同。

"My grandson has become exceptionally grabby ," Lucius said, his lips turning down disapprovingly. "And his hands are astonishingly sticky."
“我的孙子变得特别好吃了，”卢修斯说，他的嘴唇不赞同地往下转。“而且他的手粘得惊人。”

“Minny!” It was the only way Scorpius knew how to say her name and Hermione responded to it immediately, looking down to find him holding out his lion and shaking it. 
“明尼！”这是斯科皮知道如何说出她的名字的唯一方式，赫敏立即回应了它，低头发现他伸出他的狮子摇晃着它。

Hermione carefully accepted the lion in both hands with a murmured “thank you” and set it on top of the book with an air of ceremony. She knew what Scorpius wanted her to do – he had her do it two or three times a week at this point. 
赫敏小心翼翼地双手接过狮子，低声说了声“谢谢”，然后带着礼仪的气氛把它放在书上。她知道斯科皮希望她做什么——此时他让她每周做两到三次。

Drawing out her wand, she pressed the tip of it into the lion’s back and then slowly drew it up into the air. The lion rose like a marionette and Scorpius giggled delightedly when Hermione made it move towards him, leaping from the book with its floppy paws. 
她抽出魔杖，将魔杖的尖端压在狮子的背上，然后慢慢地将它拉到空中。狮子像提线木偶一样升起，当赫敏向他走来时，斯科皮高兴地咯咯笑了起来，它用松软的爪子从书上跳了下来。

“Thank you for my present, by the way,” Hermione murmured, her eyes rising to Lucius’ face as she twirled her wand to make the lion do a forward roll. “I can’t even begin to tell you how much I love it.”
“顺便说一句，谢谢你的礼物，”赫敏喃喃自语，她的眼睛抬起头看着卢修斯的脸，同时她转动着魔杖，让狮子向前翻滚。“我什至无法告诉你我有多喜欢它。”

“So you opened it,” Lucius said, sounding pleased. “In front of everyone?”
“所以你打开了它，”卢修斯说，听起来很高兴。“当着所有人的面？”

“Yes.” The lion shook its mane, prompting Scorpius to delightedly kick his legs. “Everyone else admired it, too,” she said, recalling what Draco had said about his father’s desire to show off. “In fact, Pansy Parkinson thought it was good enough to predict that you’d be getting a good –” Her eyes darted to the thoroughly distracted Scorpius. “S-h-a-g tonight.”
“是的。”狮子摇晃着它的鬃毛，促使斯科皮高兴地踢他的腿。“其他人也都很欣赏它，”她说，回忆起德拉科说过他父亲想要炫耀的话。“事实上，潘西·帕金森认为这足以预测你会得到一个好——”她的眼睛瞥向彻底分心的斯科皮。“今晚 S-h-a-g。”

Lucius coughed, struggling to keep ahold of Scorpius who was wriggling over his lap in an attempt to get closer to his dancing lion. “I always told Draco she was atrociously uncouth.” He glanced up at Hermione from under his brow, barely wincing as one of Scorpius' feet connected with his stomach. “Was she right?”
卢修斯咳嗽了一声，挣扎着抓住斯科皮，斯科皮在他的腿上扭动着，试图靠近他的舞狮。“我总是告诉德拉科她粗鲁得要命。”他从额头下抬头瞥了赫敏一眼，当斯科皮的一只脚碰到他的肚子时，他几乎没有皱起眉头。“她说得对吗？”

Hermione snorted. “Let’s just say, it's the closest I've ever gotten to thinking there might be something to Divination."
赫敏哼了一声。“这么说吧，这是我最接近于认为可能与《占卜》有关的东西。”

Scorpius finally managed to break out of Lucius' hold and threw himself on his lion with a roar, pinning it to the cushion. Dropping back with a heavy sigh, Lucius rested his elbow on the arm of the sofa and pressed a hand over his eyes. "It's been some time since I last did this – I'm exhausted."
斯科皮终于挣脱了卢修斯的束缚，咆哮着扑向他的狮子，将它固定在垫子上。卢修斯重重地叹了口气，将胳膊肘靠在沙发的扶手上，用一只手捂住了眼睛。“距离我上次这样做已经有一段时间了——我筋疲力尽。”

Laughing, Hermione pocketed her wand and lifted Scorpius into her arms. Back in possession of his toy, he was happy to curl up into her, another yawn taking hold of him as she smoothed his hair with a gentle hand.
赫敏笑着把魔杖装进口袋，把斯科皮抱进怀里。回到他的玩具里，他很高兴地蜷缩在她身上，当她用温柔的手抚平他的头发时，他又打了个哈欠。

“Maybe we’ll be putting you to bed before Scorpius,” she teased, prompting Lucius to lower his hand from his eyes just to glower at her. “You’ve never looked more like a grandfather, Lucius.”
“也许我们会在斯科皮之前让你上床睡觉，”她调侃道，促使卢修斯把手从他的眼睛上放下来，只是为了瞪她一眼。“你从来没有像个爷爷，Lucius。”

“If you are trying to provoke me into proving how un -grandfatherly I can be later,” he said sternly, “it’s working.”
“如果你是想激怒我，让我证明我以后可以多么不爷爷，”他严肃地说，“这很管用。

Hermione momentarily folded her lips between her teeth in an attempt to contain her smile. “Happy birthday to me, then.”
赫敏暂时将嘴唇夹在牙齿之间，试图抑制住她的笑容。“那么，祝我生日快乐。”

“How does Shacklebolt take his tea?”
“沙克尔是怎么喝茶的？”

Hermione glanced up from the book she was reading to find Lucius tidying his desk in preparation for Letty’s imminent tea and biscuits delivery.
赫敏从她正在阅读的书中抬起头来，发现卢修斯正在整理他的桌子，为莱蒂即将到来的茶和饼干送货做准备。

“Lucius, he won’t be here for another –” Checking her watch, Hermione tipped her head from side to side as she counted. “Maybe ten minutes or so?”
“卢修斯，他不会再来这里了——”赫敏看了看手表，一边数着一边把头左右歪着。“大概十分钟左右吧？”

“Perhaps you misheard me,” Lucius said, straightening up, his eyebrows raised. “I asked how he takes his tea, not when he will be here.”
“也许你听错了，”卢修斯说，直起身来，扬起了眉毛。“我问他是怎么喝茶的，而不是他什么时候来的。”

Rolling her eyes, Hermione closed her book with a heavy thump and pushed herself up from her reclined position on his study sofa. He had been waspish all morning. “Why do you want to know?”
赫敏翻了个白眼，重重地合上了书，从书桌上的斜倚位置站了起来。他整个上午都在被黄蜂哼叨。“你为什么想知道？”

Lucius lifted a shoulder and swiped away a spot of dust on the desk that Hermione wasn’t sure was actually there. “It gives the right impression.”
卢修斯抬起肩膀，扫掉桌子上赫敏不确定是否真的存在的灰尘。“它给人留下了正确的印象。”

As she approached him, Hermione recalled a similar discussion she had once had with Kingsley himself and scoffed, shaking her head. “You know, I think you and he could get on quite well.” She stopped at the edge of the desk and uselessly shuffled together some of his letters. “He takes it with five sugars.”
当她走近他时，赫敏想起了她曾经和金斯莱本人有过的类似讨论，她嘲笑着摇了摇头。“你知道的，我觉得你和他可以相处得很好。”她停在桌子的边缘，无用地把他的一些信拼凑在一起。“他用五颗糖吃。”

“ Five? ” Lucius’ disbelieving, faintly disgusted, tone drew Hermione’s eyes to him and she simply nodded. “Does it even all dissolve?”
“五？”卢修斯不相信，略带厌恶的语气把赫敏的目光吸引到他身上，她只是点了点头。“它甚至都溶解了吗？”

Shrugging, a smile playing about her lips, Hermione lowered her tone with a conspiratorial air. “I saw him take six once during a somewhat…fraught discussion.”
赫敏耸耸肩，嘴角挂着笑容，用阴谋论的气息压低了语气。“我看到他在某种程度上服用了六次......令人担忧的讨论。

Eyebrows fractionally twitching upwards, Lucius searched her. “What were you discussing?”
眉毛微微向上抽搐，卢修斯打量着她。“你们在讨论什么？”

“You. Obviously.”
“你。显然。

At that, a satisfied smirk passed over his face – the closest thing to a smile that she’d seen from him all day. “I’ll prepare it with five and leave the dish out. Just in case, you know.”
听到这话，他的脸上掠过一丝满意的笑容——这是她一整天从他身上看到的最接近的笑容。“我会准备五个，把菜放在外面。以防万一，你知道的。

“I’m hoping this won’t be a fraught discussion, Lucius,” Hermione said, sighing as she drew out her wand to conjure an additional chair for Kingsley. One that Lucius hadn’t shortened. “It should all be fairly straightforward.”
“我希望这不会是一场令人担忧的讨论，卢修斯，”赫敏说，一边叹了口气，一边抽出魔杖，为金斯莱多了一把椅子。卢修斯没有缩短。“一切都应该相当简单。”

A loud crack followed by a series of tremulous tinkles signalled the arrival of Letty and a heavily-laden tea tray. With a click of her fingers she sent it soaring onto the desk, Lucius’ preparatory tidying saving most of his belongings from being pushed onto the floor.
一声响亮的噼啪声，紧接着是一连串颤抖的叮当声，标志着莱蒂和一个沉甸甸的茶盘的到来。她咔嚓一声，将它高高地放在桌子上，卢修斯准备整理，避免了他大部分物品被推到地板上。

“Thank you very much, Letty,” Hermione said, surveying the tray with her hands clasped, delighted to see a small pot of honey. “Oh, and you made shortbread!”
“非常感谢你，莱蒂，”赫敏说，双手紧握着打量着托盘，很高兴看到一小罐蜂蜜。“哦，你做了酥饼！”

Letty beamed at Hermione, reaching up on her tiptoes to push the plate of biscuits into a more central position on the tray. “Thank you, Letty,” Lucius murmured distractedly, picking up a cup to ensure the chip he’d spied was just a figment of his imagination. “When he arrives just bring him straight up, will you? No need for the tour.” 
莱蒂对赫敏笑了笑，踮起脚尖把饼干盘推到托盘上更中央的位置。“谢谢你，莱蒂，”卢修斯心不在焉地喃喃自语，拿起一个杯子，确保他窥探到的芯片只是他想象中的虚构。“等他到了，就把他直接带上来，好吗？不需要参观。

Letty turned the plate of shortbread to ensure it caught the light just right and curtseyed before disappearing with a crack . Hermione eyed Lucius as he fruitlessly adjusted the tea cups and pot, his mouth tight at the corners.
莱蒂转动了一盘酥饼，确保它恰到好处地捕捉到光线，并屈膝行礼，然后啪啪一声消失了。赫敏盯着卢修斯，他徒劳地调整着茶杯和茶壶，嘴角紧闭着。

“Just…be respectful, Lucius,” Hermione urged him, continuing their discussion of Kingsley. “And it should be straightforward.”
“只是......尊重点，卢修斯，“赫敏催促他，继续他们谈论金斯莱。“而且应该很简单。”

Rubbing the side of his fingers along his forehead, Lucius placed a hand on his hip and raised his head to look at her. “Hermione, I have a healthy amount of respect for the man,” he said, adding in a lower tone, “As a spy, at the very least. He certainly had me fooled.”
卢修斯用手指在额头上摩擦，将一只手放在他的臀部上，抬起头看着她。“赫敏，我对这个人有相当的尊重，”他低声说，“至少作为一个间谍。他肯定骗了我。

“You don’t like being fooled.”
“你不喜欢被愚弄。”

“No,” was Lucius’ short reply. “But I can hardly hold it against him now, can I?”
“不，”卢修斯简短地回答。“可是我现在几乎无法对付他，对吧？”

“No,” Hermione agreed, meeting his eyes. “You can’t.”
“不，”赫敏同意道，与他的眼睛对上。“你不能。”

He’d had a somewhat unsettled air about him the whole morning and had been so irritable and unwilling to communicate anything about it to her that she’d simply locked herself away in a book. Now, she thought she saw with a little more clarity. He was nervous and, she didn’t doubt, more than a little bit resentful. Everything they’d been doing had been building up to this meeting with Kingsley and, still, he wasn’t entirely sure what to expect from it. Nor was she.
他整个上午都有些不安，而且非常烦躁，不愿意和她说任何事情，以至于她干脆把自己锁在一本书里。现在，她觉得自己看得更清楚了。他很紧张，而且，她并不怀疑，还有一点点怨恨。他们所做的一切都是为了与金斯利的这次会面而进行的，但他仍然不完全确定会有什么结果。她也不是。

Hermione extended her hand across the desk towards him and, after a moment of hesitation, he took it, his eyes locking onto where they were joined. 
赫敏隔着桌子向他伸出手，犹豫了一会儿，他接过了手，眼睛紧紧盯着他们在一起的地方。

“We’ve done everything right,” she told him, linking her fingers through his to squeeze them. “We did what we set out to do. And, besides that, Kingsley is the one who arranged this meeting, not us. Surely that bodes well.”
“我们做对了一切，”她告诉他，同时用手指穿过他的手指挤压它们。“我们做到了我们打算做的事情。而且，除此之外，金斯利是安排这次会议的人，而不是我们。这当然是个好兆头。

A knock at the door prompted Lucius to relinquish her hand and he blinked away whatever thoughts he had as he called, “come in!”. Hermione was just turning when Kingsley entered, tall and imposing in the doorway. Hermione greeted him with a warm smile, hurrying over to the door to shake his hand and pull him inside in one fluid motion. 
敲门声促使卢修斯松开了她的手，他眨了眨眼，打消了他的所有想法，他喊道：“进来！赫敏刚转身，金斯莱就进来了，她高大威严地站在门口。赫敏用温暖的微笑向他打招呼，急忙走到门口和他握手，以一个流畅的动作把他拉了进去。

“Come in, Kingsley, come in. You’re right on time.”
“进来吧，金斯利，进来。你来得正是时候。

Lucius remained behind his desk, his fingers tapping a gentle but uneven pattern on its surface as he watched Hermione usher Kingsley in his direction. 
卢修斯留在书桌后面，他的手指轻敲着桌子表面温柔但不均匀的图案，看着赫敏引导金斯莱朝着他的方向走去。

Kingsley didn’t take in his surroundings as he crossed the room. Didn’t venture into small talk by admiring the furnishings, or commenting on how nice it was to have a fire on such a cold afternoon. Instead, his eyes travelled straight from Hermione to Lucius and, when he reached the other side of Lucius’ desk, he confidently extended his hand across it. 
金斯利穿过房间时没有注意周围的环境。他没有冒险通过欣赏家具来闲聊，也没有评论在这样一个寒冷的下午生火有多好。相反，他的目光从赫敏直直地移向卢修斯，当他走到卢修斯桌子的另一边时，他自信地伸出手。

“Lucius,” he said in greeting.
“卢修斯，”他打招呼说。

Lucius’ throat jumped slightly, his fingers flexing, before he reached out and took Kingsley’s hand in his own to give it a firm, even shake. “Minister.”
卢修斯的喉咙微微跳动，他的手指弯曲着，然后他伸出手来握住金斯莱的手，用力地、均匀地摇晃着。“部长。”

There was no invitation to call him Kingsley, or even to drop his title, but Kingsley did offer Lucius a warm, genuine smile from which Hermione could just about allow herself to glean some hope. 
没有人邀请他叫金斯莱，甚至没有放弃他的头衔，但金斯利确实给了卢修斯一个温暖、真诚的微笑，赫敏几乎可以让自己从中收获一些希望。

“Please, sit down,” Lucius said, extending his hand to the fine chair that Hermione had conjured. 
“请坐，”卢修斯说，把手伸向赫敏变出的那把漂亮的椅子。

Hermione lowered herself into her own seat as Kingsley arranged his robes to sit himself beside her, saying, “Thank you for agreeing to this meeting, both of you. Though I’m sure you weren’t entirely surprised when I reached out.”
赫敏把自己放低到自己的座位上，金斯莱整理好他的长袍，自己坐在她身边，说：“谢谢你们同意这次见面，你们俩。不过我敢肯定，当我伸出援手时，你并不完全感到惊讶。

“No,” Hermione said promptly, her eyes following Lucius as he carefully pulled his chair out, last to be seated. “We’ve finished our work.”
“不，”赫敏立即说，她的眼睛跟着卢修斯小心翼翼地把椅子拉了出来，最后一个坐下。“我们已经完成了我们的工作。”

“You have indeed,” Kingsley said, his voice straining slightly as he crossed one leg over the other. “Very diligently, I might add. The members of the Wizengamot are pleased, even with those little…” Kingsley winced. “ Issues that we still have to sort out with their hereditary seats. Your suggestions are being taken on board but, er, I think discussions over the finer details might drag on a bit.”
“你确实有，”金斯莱说，他把一条腿交叉在另一条腿上，声音略微紧张。“我得补充一句，非常勤奋。威森加摩的成员们很高兴，即使有那些小小的......”金斯利皱起了眉头。“我们仍然需要通过他们的世袭席位来解决这些问题。你的建议正在被采纳，但，呃，我认为关于更细节的讨论可能会拖延一点。

“They’re being resistant?” Hermione asked, her eyes narrowing.
“他们在抵抗吗？”赫敏眯起眼睛问道。

“They’re being cautious,” Kingsley corrected, though with an understanding smile. “But I am dealing with that personally; you need not concern yourself.”
“他们很谨慎，”金斯利纠正道，尽管带着理解的微笑。“但我个人正在处理这个问题;你不用担心自己。

“We did expect as much, Hermione,” Lucius said. A spoon hovering over a cup, he looked at Kingsley and added, “Five sugars?” If Hermione didn’t know any better, she would have called his expression perfectly innocent but she did know better and so the innocence was more artful than sincere. 
“我们确实期待了那么多，赫敏，”卢修斯说。勺子悬停在杯子上，他看着金斯利，补充道：“五颗糖？如果赫敏不知道更多，她会说他的表情完全无辜，但她确实知道得更多，所以这种无辜更多的是巧妙而不是真诚。

A knowing smile on his face, Kingsley merely nodded and accepted the cup graciously when Lucius passed it over the table towards him. “Much appreciated, Lucius. Meant in more ways than one, of course – I know you’ve both been busy for some time with this. I hope the Wizengamot’s wrangling over minor details isn’t stopping you from enjoying a sense of…achievement or completion.”
金斯利脸上露出会心的笑容，只是点了点头，当卢修斯将杯子从桌子上递给他时，他优雅地接过了杯子。“非常感谢，卢修斯。当然，这意味着不止一种——我知道你们俩都忙了一段时间。我希望威森加摩家族对小细节的争吵不会阻止你享受一种......成就或完成。

“I am rather familiar with the Wizengamot’s instinct for self-preservation,” Lucius said, pouring Hermione’s tea and sliding it across the table to her. “So, no.”
“我对威森加摩的自我保护本能相当熟悉，”卢修斯说，给赫敏倒茶，把它滑过桌子递给她。“所以，没有。”

Kingsley hummed and busied himself with selecting a biscuit. “Some of them were rather surprised to see you backing a few of Hermione’s suggestions,” he said, his eyes searching the biscuit plate, Hermione knew, for the biggest one. “They pointed out you were jeopardising your own opportunity to take a seat.”
金斯利哼着歌，忙着挑选一块饼干。“他们中的一些人看到你支持赫敏的一些建议，感到相当惊讶，”他说，他的眼睛在饼干盘上寻找，赫敏知道，寻找最大的一个。“他们指出你正在危及自己获得座位的机会。”

Lucius’ eyes flicked up in a half-roll as he set the teapot down and pulled his own cup towards himself. “I’m sure a great many things about me would surprise them these days,” he said. Then, with an opaque smile, he added, “But, the way I see it, a future Minister might see fit to award me with a Wizengamot seat on the basis of my own merits.” Lucius' eyes drifted to Hermione and she flared her nostrils at him in an attempt to tell him to shut up. “Provided I ever have the opportunity to exhibit them again.”
卢修斯眨了眨眼睛，半翻了个白眼，放下茶壶，把自己的杯子拉向自己。“我敢肯定，这些天我的很多事情都会让他们感到惊讶，”他说。然后，他带着不透明的笑容补充道，“但是，在我看来，未来的部长可能会根据我自己的优点，认为合适的时候会授予我一个威森加摩的席位。卢修斯的眼睛飘向赫敏，她朝他张大了鼻孔，试图让他闭嘴。“只要我有机会再次展出它们。”

Fortunately, Kingsley was distracted by the act of dipping his biscuit in his tea. “Speaking of which, I must say, Lucius –” He paused to take a bite and give an appreciative hum at the buttery flavour. “I didn’t expect you to see this through. Not that I mean to be rude.”
幸运的是，金斯利被将饼干浸入茶中的行为分散了注意力。“说到这个，我必须说，卢修斯——”他停下来咬了一口，对着黄油的味道赞赏地哼了一声。“我没想到你会把这件事搞定。我不是故意粗鲁的。

“Is that so?” Lucius’ smile was polite but tight.
“是这样吗？”卢修斯的笑容很有礼貌，但很紧绷。

“Well, our last agreement ended up rather dead in the water, didn’t it? You’re not a man to suffer being fooled – not that it was a deliberate act, I want that to be clear.” Lucius nodded his understanding, his shoulders lowering imperceptibly. “You didn’t have much reason to trust me when I said I would reward you for your pains and yet here we are.”
“嗯，我们上次的协议最后还是泡汤了，不是吗？你不是一个可以被愚弄的人——不是说这是故意的行为，我想说清楚这一点。卢修斯点点头表示理解，他的肩膀难以察觉地低下了。“当我说我会报答你的痛苦时，你没有太多理由相信我，但我们却在这里。”

“I didn’t trust you,” Lucius said shortly. “Not that I mean to be rude .” His eyes darted to Hermione, his expression softening. “But I had reasons other than myself to see this through.”
“我不信任你，”卢修斯很快说。“我不是故意粗鲁。”他的眼睛瞪向赫敏，他的表情变得柔和了。“但除了我自己之外，我还有其他理由要把这件事搞定。”

Kingsley’s eyes also travelled to Hermione who, her cheeks pink, tried to cover most of her face by drinking her tea. “I thought so,” Kingsley said, disguising a small smile by taking another bite of biscuit. “And I’ve heard as much.”
金斯莱的目光也转向了赫敏，她的脸颊是粉红色的，试图通过喝茶来遮住她的大部分脸。“我想是的，”金斯利说，又咬了一口饼干，掩饰了一丝微笑。“我听到的也一样。”

If at all possible, Hermione went more pink. When she and Lucius had started working together, it had been a partnership of interest to the wider wizarding world so the announcement in the Prophet had been natural. When the Wizengamot had started actually passing their laws and the nature of what they were doing had become clear, however, people had started to look even closer, many of them with raised eyebrows. Lucius’ motivations, for instance, had been the subject of more than one Daily Prophet column. 
如果可能的话，赫敏会变得更粉红色。当她和卢修斯开始合作时，这是更广泛的魔法世界感兴趣的伙伴关系，所以先知的宣布是很自然的。然而，当威森加摩真正开始通过他们的法律并且他们所做的事情的性质变得清晰时，人们开始更加仔细地观察，其中许多人扬起了眉毛。例如，卢修斯的动机不止一篇《预言家日报》专栏的主题。

The publication of Hermione’s book had rekindled interest by making it apparent that Hermione Granger and Lucius Malfoy’s mysterious ‘acquaintanceship’ went back even farther than most had initially thought and the rumours had started to gather pace. Several anonymous sources leaking their attendance at the event Lucius had arranged for Hermione had not helped matters. 
赫敏的书的出版重新点燃了人们的兴趣，因为它清楚地表明赫敏·格兰杰和卢修斯·马尔福的神秘“熟人”关系比大多数人最初想象的还要久远，谣言已经开始加速。几个匿名消息来源泄露了他们参加卢修斯为赫敏安排的活动，但无济于事。

One in particular had been more than happy to reveal Narcissa’s declarations about her divorce and, suddenly, Hermione’s perennial single status in the aftermath of her relationship with Ron was not treated with pity but suspicion. Had she broken up the Malfoy marriage? Narcissa Malfoy’s unavailability for comment made a lot of people feel like they could guess ‘yes’. 
特别是一个特别高兴地透露了纳西莎关于她离婚的声明，突然之间，赫敏在与罗恩的关系之后常年单身的状态并没有被怜悯而是怀疑。她破坏了马尔福的婚姻吗？纳西莎·马尔福无法发表评论，这让很多人觉得他们可以猜到“是”。

Shortly after the publication of her book, a particularly vicious Witch Weekly column had alleged that the wizarding world’s golden girl was actually a nasty little gold digger and Lucius was undoubtedly only using her to get his freedom back. Romance or Reciprocity? had been the headline and Hermione had actually had to check that Rita Skeeter’s name wasn’t attached to it. 
在她的书出版后不久，《女巫周刊》的一篇特别恶毒的专栏声称，魔法世界的金童玉女实际上是一个令人讨厌的小淘金者，卢修斯无疑只是在利用她来夺回自由。 浪漫还是互惠？ 一直是头条新闻，赫敏实际上不得不检查一下丽塔·斯基特的名字没有附在上面。

The easiest response had been to stop reading the Prophet and Witch Weekly . Though Ginny assured Hermione that it had all died down quite a lot since that initial flurry of articles, Hermione didn’t feel a need to find out for herself.
最简单的反应是停止阅读先知和女巫周刊。虽然金妮向赫敏感到，自从最初的那一连串文章以来，一切都已经平息了很多，但赫敏并不觉得有必要自己去了解。

“People,” Lucius had said, “will say and think what they want regardless of what we tell them.” Hermione had never especially enjoyed explaining herself to gossips anyway. But Kingsley wasn’t really a gossip.
“人们，”卢修斯曾说过，“无论我们告诉他们什么，他们都会说什么，想什么就想什么。无论如何，赫敏从来都不是特别喜欢向八卦解释自己。但金斯利并不是一个真正的八卦。

“Kingsley –” Hermione began, leaning forward in her seat. 
“金斯莱——”赫敏开始说话，在座位上身体前倾。

“It’s really none of my business, Hermione,” Kingsley said, pausing to take a long drink of tea. “You’ve both done as I asked and individual motivations are really inconsequential in the grand scheme of it all. To me, at least – I have what I need.”
“这真的不关我的事，赫敏，”金斯莱说，停下来喝了一大口茶。“你们俩都按照我的要求做了，在这一切的宏伟计划中，个人动机真的是无关紧要的。至少对我来说——我有我需要的东西。

Lucius nodded his agreement with Kingsley and Hermione pursed her lips. They were such an odd pair to be sitting with – she couldn’t quite get comfortable in her seat, not knowing whether she might, at any moment, have to intervene in a disagreement or defend herself from an accusation of naivety.
卢修斯点头同意金斯莱的意见，赫敏抿了抿嘴唇。他们是一对奇怪的搭档——她在座位上不太舒服，不知道她是否随时必须干预分歧或保护自己免受天真的指责。

“But that’s why I’m here,” Kingsley said, his face brightening. “You did see it through and, as a result, I intend to fulfil my side of the deal.”
“但这就是我在这里的原因，”金斯利说，他的脸上露出了光彩。“你确实看透了它，因此，我打算履行我这边的交易。”

At Kingsley’s abrupt declaration, Hermione spluttered into her cup, the hot tea splashing her nose. She looked to Lucius, who had gone quite pale, as he said, “You mean –”
听到金斯莱的突然宣布，赫敏啪啪地倒在了她的杯子里，热茶溅到了她的鼻子上。她看向卢修斯，卢修斯脸色苍白，他说道，“你是说——”

“Your release,” Kingsley said, his conversational tone slightly muffled by his last bite of biscuit. “I’m here to tell you that you will have it. The Wizengamot has agreed.”
“你放开了，”金斯利说，他说话的语气被他最后一口饼干略微压低了。“我在这里告诉你，你会得到它。威森加摩已经同意了。

“What are the terms?” Lucius asked, his voice impressively even. 
“条款是什么？”卢修斯问道，他的声音令人印象深刻。

“House arrest lifted,” Kingsley said with a firm nod. “Magic dampener removed.”
“软禁解除，”金斯利坚定地点头说。“魔术阻尼器已移除。”

Hermione laughed, delighted, but Lucius looked like he didn’t know quite how to behave and Kingsley’s eyes were on him as he said, “You surprised us, Lucius. Am I right in saying we’ve returned the favour?”
赫敏高兴地笑了起来，但卢修斯看起来不太懂得该如何表现，金斯莱的眼睛盯着他说，“卢修斯，你让我们感到惊讶。我说我们回报了这个人情，对吗？

Running a hand over his mouth, Lucius frowned slightly. “I expected I would have to do more convincing. If not with you, with the Wizengamot.”
卢修斯用一只手捂住嘴，微微皱起眉头。“我以为我必须做更多的事情来说服人。如果不和你在一起，就和威森加摩一起。

“I expect you will have plenty of people to convince in the coming months,” Kingsley said, his expression quite serious. “It’s been ten years but people don’t forget. The Wizengamot and I have agreed, however, that you have shown sufficient evidence of a will to change and to participate in the kind of society we’re trying to build. We’re going to let you prove it.” 
“我预计在接下来的几个月里你会有很多人来说服，”金斯利说，他的表情相当严肃。“十年过去了，但人们不会忘记。然而，威森加摩和我都同意，你已经拿出了足够的证据来证明你愿意改变并参与我们正在努力建立的那种社会。我们会让你证明这一点。

Lucius nodded slowly but Hermione could tell he was waiting for something. Some kind of condition, perhaps. 
卢修斯缓缓地点点头，但赫敏看得出来他在等待什么。也许是某种情况。

“There will, of course, be a probationary period,” Kingsley added. “We must take precautions. The Wizengamot were keen for eighteen months, I suggested nine months. So we have compromised and would like to propose a year to you.”
“当然，会有一个试用期，”金斯利补充道。“我们必须采取预防措施。威森加摩热衷于十八个月，我建议九个月。所以我们已经妥协了，想向你提议一年。

At that, Lucius’ eyes narrowed but he kept his tone politely curious when he asked, “And what will happen in this year?”
听到这话，卢修斯眯起了眼睛，但当他问道时，他保持着礼貌的语气，带着好奇，“那今年会发生什么？

“We’ll keep a close eye on you,” Kingsley explained, like he was surprised Lucius would even have to ask. “Send the occasional Auror to pop in – unannounced, naturally – for inspections. You’ll be the first on our list for any raids. And, of course, we’d like to encourage some more publicly-minded action from you to keep our minds at ease.”
“我们会密切关注你的，”金斯莱解释道，就像他很惊讶卢修斯竟然会问这个问题一样。“派偶尔的傲罗来——自然是不事先通知的——来检查。您将是我们任何突袭名单上的第一个。当然，我们想鼓励您采取一些更具公共意识的行动，让我们放心。

Lucius, whose lip had curled more with every word that Kingsley spoke, nodded once slowly. “I see,” he said, his eyes searching Kingsley’s placid expression while his fingers drummed a contemplative pattern on his desk. 
卢修斯的嘴唇随着金斯莱说的每一句话而更加卷曲，他缓缓地点了点头。“我明白了，”他说，他的眼睛寻找着金斯利平静的表情，同时他的手指在他的桌子上敲打着沉思的图案。

So abruptly it made Hermione jump, Lucius pulled open a drawer in his desk. He withdrew a thin, rectangular book from the drawer and dropped it on the desk with a thwack , drawing a quill towards himself. Hermione squinted at the book as he flipped it open and, on recognising it, her eyes widened.
突然间，赫敏跳了起来，卢修斯拉开了他书桌上的一个抽屉。他从抽屉里拿出一本薄薄的长方形书，砰的一声把它扔在桌子上，抽出一支羽毛笔朝自己走来。赫敏眯着眼睛看着那本书，他翻开了它，一认出它，她睁大了眼睛。

“Lucius –” she started, glancing anxiously at Kingsley, who merely looked on with mild-mannered interest. Money. He was honestly going to try money with Kingsley . Oh, I could kill him! Hermione thought furiously.
“卢修斯——”她开始说，焦急地瞥了一眼金斯莱，而金斯利只是以温和的兴趣看着。钱。老实说，他打算和金斯利一起试试钱。 哦，我可以杀了他！ 赫敏愤怒地想着。

“We have done things your way for quite a while, Hermione,” Lucius said calmly, inking his quill. “And now we will try mine.”
“我们已经按照你的方式做了很长一段时间了，赫敏，”卢修斯平静地说，用他的羽毛笔涂上墨水。“现在我们试试我的。”

Clearing his throat, he contemplated the cheque book with pursed lips and then scribbled a number onto it before signing his signature with a flourish. Depositing his quill on the desk, Lucius neatly ripped the cheque from its book and slid it across the table, meeting Kingsley’s eyes as he did so. “Do tell me if I’ve missed the mark here, Minister. Hard thing to put a price on.”
清清嗓子，他抿着嘴唇凝视着支票簿，然后在上面潦草地写了一个数字，然后华丽地签了字。卢修斯把羽毛笔放在桌子上，利落地从书上撕下支票，滑过桌子，与金斯莱的眼睛对上。“请告诉我，我是不是在这里错过了，部长。很难定价。

Hermione gaped as Kingsley leaned forward and picked up the cheque without hesitation. For a fraction of a second, she thought she saw his mask slip, his eyebrows twitching upwards. Within the space of a blink, his face was unreadable again. 
赫敏目瞪口呆，金斯莱身体前倾，毫不犹豫地捡起了支票。有那么一瞬间，她以为自己看到了他的面具滑落，他的眉毛向上抽搐。眨眼间，他的脸色又变得难以捉摸。

“This is…” Kingsley’s eyes rose above the cheque to meet Lucius’ even stare. “Generous.”
“这是......”金斯莱的眼睛从支票上抬起，与卢修斯平和的目光相遇。“慷慨。”

A slight incline of Lucius’ head spoke to his agreement with Kingsley’s assessment. “Is it generous enough for a looser leash?” he asked, drawing, as far as Hermione was concerned, arse-clenchingly close to sarcasm for a man who had just bribed a politician.
卢修斯微微歪着头，表明他同意金斯莱的评估。“它够慷慨地放一条更松散的皮带吗？”他问道，对赫敏来说，他紧握着屁股，几乎是在讽刺一个刚刚贿赂了一位政客的男人。

Eyeing the number again, Kingsley tipped his head consideringly. “Yes,” he said slowly. “I am willing to say we have an understanding.” Hermione spied a quiver at the corner of Lucius’ mouth and her disbelieving eyes travelled once again to Kingsley, who was quite serious as he added, “As long as you understand that this generosity will not stop us from restoring you to your current state if you are found to be in contravention of our laws again.”
金斯利再次盯着这个数字，若有所思地歪了歪头。“是的，”他缓缓地说。“我愿意说我们达成了谅解。”赫敏在卢修斯的嘴角窥探了一个颤抖，她难以置信的眼神再次看向金斯莱，金斯莱相当严肃地补充道，“只要你明白，如果你再次被发现违反我们的法律，这种慷慨不会阻止我们把你恢复到现在的状态。

“Naturally,” Lucius said with a remarkable amount of grace given the circumstances. “I would like it –” He gestured to the cheque. “The majority of it, at least, to go to the Ministry’s fund for Half-blood and Muggleborn students who come into our world in…less-than-ideal circumstances, shall we say. I’m aware that it tends to be neglected and I imagine it’s become even less of a priority lately.” Lucius paused, studying Kingsley. “Unless, of course, you had a rather more specific cause in mind when you were needling me?”
“当然，”考虑到当时的情况，卢修斯带着非凡的优雅说道。“我想要它——”他指了指支票。“至少，其中大部分都捐给了魔法部的基金，这些基金是为了资助那些来到我们这个世界的混血儿和麻瓜出身的学生......不太理想的情况，容我们说。我知道它往往被忽视，我想它最近变得更不重要了。卢修斯停顿了一下，打量着金斯利。“当然，除非你在给我针刺的时候，心里想着一个更具体的原因？”

A shadow of a smile passed over Kingsley’s face. Then, apparently oblivious to Hermione’s gaping mouth, he neatly folded the cheque in half and slipped it into his robes. “An admirable cause – the Wizengamot will be delighted. They were reluctant to begin putting their own funds towards it but we’re growing close to that becoming necessary.”
金斯莱的脸上掠过一丝微笑。然后，他显然没有注意到赫敏张大的嘴巴，他整齐地把支票对折，塞进了他的袍子里。“一个令人钦佩的事业——威森加摩会很高兴。他们不愿意开始将自己的资金投入其中，但我们正在逐渐接近成为必要。

Hermione sat forward to speak but a very sharp look from Lucius made her freeze. She could practically hear him asking her to, please, save her righteous homily for literally any other time. Perhaps sensing Hermione’s discomfort, Kingsley addressed her with an indulgent smile. 
赫敏坐上前准备说话，但卢修斯非常锐利的眼神让她僵住了。她几乎可以听到他要求她，拜托，把她正义的讲道留到任何其他时间。也许是感觉到赫敏的不安，金斯莱对她露出一个纵容的微笑。

“Isn’t it good, Hermione,” he asked, “that such an important fund will finally get a much-needed boost? Lucius is right – what with years of rebuilding efforts at the castle soaking up Ministry attention and money, it has been neglected for far too long.”
“赫敏，”他问道，“这么重要的基金终于得到了急需的推动，这不是很好吗？卢修斯是对的——多年来城堡的重建工作消耗了魔法部的关注和金钱，它已经被忽视了太久了。

Hermione nodded several times before the words came. “Y-yes. Yes, it’s wonderful. Of course, Kingsley.” 
赫敏点了好几次头，才说出话来。“是的。是的，这太棒了。当然，金斯利。

“Would you like the fund to bear your name going forward, Lucius?” Kingsley asked in a way that was almost teasing. “I know you’ve been fond of placing such conditions on your donations in the past.”
“卢修斯，你希望这个基金以后以后以你的名字命名吗？”金斯莱以一种近乎戏弄的方式问道。“我知道你过去一直喜欢在你的捐款上设置这样的条件。”

“If you’re going to put anyone’s name on it, make it hers,” Lucius said, jerking his head in Hermione’s direction. 
“如果你要把任何人的名字写在上面，就把它写成她的名字，”卢修斯说，猛地把头转向赫敏的方向。

“Please don’t,” she said quickly, her hands landing flat on the desk to emphasise her point. “It’s fine as it is.”
“请不要，”她迅速地说，双手平放在桌子上以强调她的观点。“就这样吧。”

Chuckling, Kingsley nodded. “All that remains, then, is to arrange a date for the removal of your Magic Dampener.” His eyes travelled down Lucius’ person, as though he might be able to see it through the surface of the desk. “I take it you’d like that to be sooner rather than later?”
金斯利咯咯地笑着点点头。“那么，剩下的就是安排一个移除你的魔法阻尼器的日期。”他的眼睛顺着卢修斯的身体扫视，仿佛他能透过桌子的表面看到它。“我想你希望那件事早点而不是晚点？”

“I’d like it to be ‘now’ ,” Lucius suggested dryly. “But I suppose that would be asking for the impossible, hm?” 
“我希望是'现在'，”卢修斯干巴巴地建议道。“但我想那会要求不可能的事情，嗯？”

Kingsley nodded gravely. “There are processes, Lucius. Paperwork. You know this. I’ll set it all in motion on my return to the Ministry. You’ll receive an owl with a date and a time within the next couple of weeks or so.”
金斯莱严肃地点点头。“有流程，Lucius。文书工作。你知道的。我会在我回到魔法部后把这一切付诸实施。在接下来的几周左右，你会收到一只带有日期和时间的猫头鹰。

“How long do you think it’ll be, Kingsley?” Hermione asked, her eyes darting to Lucius. “For them to remove the Magic Dampener?”
“你觉得这要多久呢，金斯莱？”赫敏问道，她的眼睛瞪向卢修斯。“让他们去掉魔法阻尼器？”

“Oh, a couple of months. Four at most.” Perhaps spying the corners of Lucius’ mouth tightening, Kingsley cast him an admonishing look. “You’ve waited this long, Lucius. What’s a couple more months for a sentence effectively halved?”
“哦，几个月。最多四个。也许是窥探到卢修斯紧绷的嘴角，金斯利向他投来一个警告的眼神。“你等了这么久了，Lucius。实际上减半的刑期再多几个月算什么？

“It is, precisely, a ‘couple more months’,” Lucius said sharply, before a glare of warning from Hermione prompted him to reluctantly add, “Minister.” 
“准确地说，就是'再过几个月'，”卢修斯尖锐地说，然后赫敏警告的目光促使他不情愿地补充道，“部长。

Patting his breast pocket where Lucius’ cheque resided, Kingsley said, “You and I both know there’s only so much we can do before the red tape becomes too thick to cut through. In the meantime, I can promise you that I will do all in my power to prevent any delays.”
金斯利拍了拍他胸前的口袋里放着卢修斯的支票，说道，“你和我都知道，在繁文缛节变得太厚而无法突破之前，我们能做的只有这么多。与此同时，我可以向你保证，我将尽我所能防止任何延误。

“That’s fine, Kingsley,” Hermione interjected before Lucius could say anything else, her hands tightly gripping her cup in her lap. They had what they wanted, she told herself. Well, in a couple of months they’d have it and she’d be damned if she was going to let Lucius ruin it for himself because he hated being told no. He’d already risked it all with his stupid bribe. “Thank you.”
“没关系，金斯莱，”赫敏在卢修斯还没来得及说什么之前打断了她，她的手紧紧地握着膝盖上的杯子。他们得到了他们想要的，她告诉自己。好吧，几个月后他们就会得到它，如果她要让卢修斯毁了它，因为他讨厌被拒绝，她就该死了。他已经冒着一切风险用他那愚蠢的贿赂来了。“谢谢你。”

“No need for thanks, Hermione,” Kingsley said, setting his tea on the desk and turning to her properly. If he noticed that she was sitting slightly lower than both he and Lucius, he didn’t comment. “Though, while Lucius’ work is done, I have some news about yours.”
“不用谢，赫敏，”金斯莱说，把茶放在桌子上，然后适当地转向她。如果他注意到她坐得比他和Lucius都低一点，他就不多说了。“不过，虽然卢修斯的工作已经完成，但我有一些关于你的消息。”

Hermione tried not to look at Lucius who, she could feel, was staring intently at the side of her face. “Oh, yes?” she asked, just about managing polite interest. 
赫敏尽量不去看卢修斯，她能感觉到，卢修斯正专注地盯着她的脸侧。“哦，是吗？” 她问道，只是为了管理礼貌的利益。

“Griffiths is retiring as planned,” Kingsley said. “And that Deputy Head of DMLE job will be opening up in September. I realise we’ve discussed it but I am, right now, extending a formal invitation to you to apply for the job.”
“格里菲斯将按计划退休，”金斯利说。“DMLE 副主任的职位将于 9 月开放。我知道我们已经讨论过了，但我现在正式邀请你申请这份工作。

Dropping her gaze to the tea she was clutching in her lap, Hermione watched the steam swirl up towards her. She’d had a lot of time to consider her future – there were, increasingly, very few nights when she didn’t use the period before sleep to map out what she could do with her future. There were, she mused, tea leaves at the bottom of the cup she was holding that some might tell her were guidance enough. If only it were that easy.
赫敏把目光投向她腿上攥着的茶，看着蒸汽向她旋转。她有很多时间来考虑自己的未来——越来越多的夜晚，她不利用睡前的这段时间来规划她能对自己的未来做些什么。她沉思着，她拿着的杯子底部有茶叶，有些人可能会说这已经足够指导了。要是这么简单就好了。

She was, of course, a published author and Catherine had told her in no uncertain terms that, after the success of Sonorus , she could be published again if she so desired. But she had no such desire. Hermione rather felt she had exorcised something with that work and she was happy to leave it behind her. 
当然，她是一位出版过的作家，凯瑟琳毫不含糊地告诉她，在《索诺鲁斯》成功之后，如果她愿意，她可以再次出版。但她没有这样的愿望。赫敏反而觉得她用那件作品驱散了什么东西，她很高兴把它抛在脑后。

Lucius had told her that, if she truly didn’t want to return to the Ministry, he would financially support whatever she wanted to do. “Set up an institution,” he had suggested one evening over dinner. “A charity. Open a shop that sells one type of lemon cake and literally nothing else. Do whatever you bloody want – you can.”
卢修斯告诉她，如果她真的不想回到魔法部，他会在经济上支持她想做的任何事情。“建立一个机构，”他在一天晚上的晚餐时建议道。“一个慈善机构。开一家卖一种柠檬蛋糕的商店，几乎不卖其他任何东西。你想做什么就做什么——你可以。

“Don’t be so glib,” she’d huffed, stabbing a potato with her fork. “You know I can’t just ‘do whatever I want.’ It doesn’t work like that.”
“别这么油嘴滑舌，”她气喘吁吁地用叉子戳了戳一个土豆。“你知道我不能随便'做任何我想做的事'。”事情不是那样的。

“Hermione,” he’d said. “When will you accept that I can make sure that it does ?”
“赫敏，”他说。“你什么时候会接受我能确保它能做到？”

When she’d looked up at him, wide-eyed, he’d explained, “Your options are not ‘Ministry of Magic’ or ‘destitution’.” Taking a drink of wine, he’d shrugged. “If I can’t use my money to make you happy, what’s the point? I mean, really, you’re depriving both of us pleasure by refusing it which is, quite frankly, bordering on puritanical.”
当她睁大眼睛看着他时，他解释说，“你的选择不是'魔法部'或'贫困'。喝了一口酒，他耸了耸肩。“如果我不能用我的钱让你开心，那又有什么意义呢？我的意思是，真的，你拒绝它剥夺了我们俩的快乐，坦率地说，这近乎清教徒式的。

There was a dizzying amount of freedom in Lucius’ offer. And yet. And yet . Hermione’s mind continued to linger on Kingsley’s suggestion that she might one day replace him as Minister for Magic. Lucius’ offer of money could get her a lot of things but only she , Hermione, could get herself in that office. The idea of that appealed – made her hungry to prove herself.
卢修斯的提议中充满了令人眼花缭乱的自由。而。而。赫敏的脑海里继续徘徊在金斯莱的建议上，她有一天可能会取代他成为魔法部长。卢修斯的钱可以让她得到很多东西，但只有她，赫敏，能让自己进入那个办公室。这个想法很吸引人——让她渴望证明自己。

“Thank you, Kingsley,” she finally said, her stomach flipping giddily in anticipation of her next words. “I’ll get my application to you on Monday.” Hermione met Kingsley’s eyes and she saw a gleam of pride in them that made her grin. “I want it.”
“谢谢你，金斯利，”她终于说了，她的肚子晕眩地翻动着，期待着她接下来的话。“我会在周一把我的申请给你。”赫敏与金斯莱的眼睛相遇，她在眼睛里看到了一丝自豪，让她咧嘴一笑。“我想要。”

“Excellent, Hermione,” Kingsley said with a sincerity that only made her grin grow wider. “Truly, I’m delighted to hear it. And with a September start date, you’ll have a chance to enjoy a nice long summer.” His eyes slid to Lucius. “Whatever it may involve.” 
“太好了，赫敏，”金斯莱真诚地说，这只会让她的笑容变得更大。“真的，我很高兴听到这个消息。随着 9 月的开始日期，您将有机会享受一个美好的漫长夏天。他的目光滑向卢修斯。“无论它可能涉及什么。”

Ignoring Hermione’s furious blush, Kingsley cleared his throat and placed his hands on his knees to push himself to his feet. “Now,” he said, looking down at them. “I don’t wish to overstay my welcome and I am exceptionally busy so, if you don’t mind, I’ll thank you for your hospitality and be on my way.”
金斯莱无视赫敏愤怒的脸红，清了清嗓子，双手放在膝盖上，让自己站起来。“现在，”他说，低头看着他们。“我不想逾期逗留，而且我特别忙，所以，如果你不介意的话，我会感谢你的款待，然后上路。”

Hermione and Lucius rose to their feet in tandem, Lucius reaching across the table to shake his hand with a touch more enthusiasm than he had at the start of the meeting. “Would you like me to get Letty to –
赫敏和卢修斯一起站起来，卢修斯伸手越过桌子握手，比会议开始时更加热情。“你要不要我让莱蒂——

“No, Lucius,” Kingsley said with a shake of his head. “I can remember my way, thank you. And if I forget, I passed a very…friendly portrait of a witch just outside your door who told me it would be her pleasure to show me the sights of Malfoy Manor.” He raised his eyebrows and shook Hermione’s hand, adding in an undertone, “Make of that what you will.”
“不，卢修斯，”金斯利摇了摇头说。“我记得我的方式，谢谢你。如果我忘记了，我通过了一个非常......你门外的一位女巫的友好肖像告诉我，她很高兴能带我去看看马尔福庄园的风景。他扬起眉毛，握了握赫敏的手，低调地补充道，“随你便吧。

In a swirl of robes, Kingsley turned on his heel and swept towards the door, Hermione hurrying along at his side to open it for him. He clapped a hand on her shoulder in silent thanks and paused in the doorway to say, “I’ll be in touch,” before he departed, leaving a heavy silence behind him.
在一团长袍的漩涡中，金斯莱转过身来，朝门扫去，赫敏急忙走到他身边为他开门。他用一只手拍了拍她的肩膀，无声地感谢，然后在门口停下来说：“我会联系的，”然后他离开了，身后留下了沉重的沉默。

Hermione closed the door after Kingsley and stood with her hand on the handle for a long moment before she turned to Lucius. He was slouching in his chair, his elbows resting on its arms and his lips pushed out in a half pout that distinctly said ‘let’s get this over with’.
赫敏在金斯莱身后关上了门，手扶着门把手站了很久，然后转向卢修斯。他懒洋洋地坐在椅子上，胳膊肘靠在椅子的手臂上，半撅着嘴唇，清楚地在说“让我们结束这件事”。

“Tell me, Lucius,” she said, fighting to keep her tone level, “what exactly did you think you were doing there?”
“告诉我，卢修斯，”她说，努力保持语气平静，“你到底觉得你在那儿做什么？

“What was expected of me.” Lucius’ nonchalant shrug did not help Hermione’s efforts to keep a lid on her temper.
“对我的期望。”卢修斯漫不经心的耸耸肩并没有帮助赫敏努力控制自己的脾气。

“Bribery,” she snapped, bringing her hands to her hips as her eyes narrowed. “ Bribery is expected of you?”
“贿赂，”她厉声说，双手放在臀部上，眼睛眯起。“你被要求贿赂吗？”

“By the Wizengamot, yes,” Lucius said, his tone maddeningly matter-of-fact. 
“对了，威森加摩，是的，”卢修斯说，他的语气带着令人发狂的事实。

“But not by Kingsley,” Hermione cried, throwing her hands out. “It’s Kingsley! I honestly can’t believe he didn’t rip up that cheque and throw it back in your face. You could have ruined everything , Lucius. Why would you –”
“但不是金斯莱，”赫敏喊道，伸出双手。“是金斯利！老实说，我不敢相信他没有撕毁那张支票并把它扔回你的脸上。你本来可以毁掉一切的，卢修斯。你为什么——”

“I am not a careless fool, Hermione,” Lucius said sharply, pushing himself up straighter. “Clearly I understood what was happening a damn sight better than you.”
“我不是个粗心大意的傻瓜，赫敏，”卢修斯尖锐地说，把自己撑得更直了。“显然，我比你更了解发生了什么。”

“Kingsley was not asking you for money .”
“金斯利不是要你钱。”

“Don’t be so naive,” he said, his lip curling. “That little ‘probationary’ period he was talking about is not standard. Auror visits? Raids? It was designed specifically to irk me.”
“别这么天真，”他说，嘴唇弯起。“他所说的那个小小的'试用期'并不标准。傲罗来访？袭击？它是专门为激怒我而设计的。

赫敏用手指搂住他，向后退着走进门口，把他拉到春末的阳光下。他在阳光下快速眨了眨眼，因为他整个上午都被困在庄园里。“你感觉如何？还好吗？

“It was rather anticlimactic,” he said, with an almost bemused air. Hermione watched him lift his foot from the ground, turning his ankle where the Magic Dampener had once sat, like he couldn’t quite believe it was gone. 
“这真是太不合时宜了，”他说，语气几乎是困惑的。赫敏看着他把脚从地上抬起来，把脚踝扭到魔法阻尼器曾经坐过的地方，就像他不太相信它已经消失了一样。

“Have you thought about what you’d like to do, father?” Draco called from his seat by the table, his attention partially on Scorpius, who was clinging with one hand to the leg of his trousers.
“爸爸，你有没有想过你想做什么？”德拉科从桌边的座位上喊道，他的注意力一部分集中在斯科皮身上，他一只手紧紧抓住他的裤腿。

“You need a wand,” Astoria suggested brightly when Lucius didn’t seem inclined to respond.
“你需要一根魔杖，”阿斯托利亚在卢修斯似乎不愿意回答时爽朗地建议道。

Lucius nodded his agreement and said, “I do” but didn’t otherwise move. Eyes combing his profile, Hermione said, “I feel I should point out that you and I have been together for nearly two years and you’ve never taken me out.”
卢修斯点头表示同意，说：“我愿意”，但没有动。赫敏的眼睛梳理着他的个人资料，说，“我觉得我应该指出，你和我已经在一起快两年了，你从来没有带我出去过。

His eyes snapped to hers and she thought she saw a flicker of mischief in them that made her let out a quiet breath of relief – he was fine. Would be fine. “Ice cream?” he asked. “I know you’ve enjoyed that before.”
他的眼睛猛地盯着她，她觉得她看到了他们身上一丝恶作剧，这让她轻声松了一口气——他没事。会没事的。“冰淇淋？”“我知道你以前很喜欢。”

“Oh, fuck off,” said Hermione, her wide grin taking the sting out of her rebuke. The last time she’d been on a date in that ice cream parlour, she’d been stabbing her spoon into the cardboard cup, pretending the pale lavender ice cream was Lucius’ face. 
“哦，滚蛋，”赫敏说，她灿烂的笑容消除了她斥责的刺痛。上次她在那个冰淇淋店约会时，她一直把勺子捅进纸板杯里，假装淡淡的薰衣草冰淇淋是卢修斯的脸。

From Draco’s side, Scorpius waved his toy lion aloft, roaring to get their attention. Cato trotted over and sniffed curiously at the toy, which Scorpius drew protectively into his chest. An offended look—all too reminiscent of Lucius and Draco—passed over his face as he spied the moisture left by Cato’s nose.  
在德拉科的身边，斯科皮高高地挥舞着他的玩具狮子，咆哮着引起他们的注意。卡托小跑过来，好奇地嗅了嗅那个玩具，斯科皮保护性地把玩具拉进了他的胸口。当他窥探到Cato鼻子留下的湿气时，一种被冒犯的眼神——太让人想起了Lucius和Draco——在他的脸上掠过。

“Look at that,” Hermione said, sliding her hand into Lucius’ and squeezing. “Scorpius is telling you to be brave! Isn’t that sweet?”
“看看那个，”赫敏说，把手滑进卢修斯的手里，捏了捏。“斯科皮告诉你要勇敢！ 那不是很甜吗？

“I hate you,” Lucius growled, though without dropping her hand. 
“我恨你，”卢修斯咆哮着，尽管她的手并没有放下。

Draco rolled his eyes. “Nobody believes that anymore,” he said, lifting his tea to his lips to blow away the steam. “Come on, what are you going to do?”
德拉科翻了个白眼。“没有人再相信了，”他说，把茶举到嘴边，把蒸汽吹走。“来吧，你打算做什么？”

Lucius’ eyes darted between Hermione at his side and his family before him. “A wand,” he finally said firmly, turning his head to Hermione. “If you’ll join me?”
卢修斯的眼睛在他身边的赫敏和他面前的家人之间来回扫视。“一根魔杖，”他终于坚定地说，把头转向赫敏。“你愿意和我一起吗？”

“Of course I will.” Hermione smiled and turned towards the manor, filled with purpose as she pulled him back inside. 
“我当然会。”赫敏微笑着转向庄园，满怀目标地把他拉回了屋里。

They’d go now. Rip off the bandage. Only a few days before she’d struggled to imagine walking hand-in-hand with Lucius through Diagon Alley, subject to the watchful stares of all the witches and wizards that would be shopping and seeking out gossip. It had seemed a slightly unreal image. But she would do it and, actually, now the thought of it elicited a small thrill that made her walk faster.
他们现在就走。撕掉绷带。就在几天前，她还在努力想象与卢修斯手牵手走过对角巷，受到所有正在购物和寻找八卦的女巫和巫师的注视。这似乎是一个有点不真实的画面。但她会这样做的，实际上，现在一想到它就引起了一种小小的兴奋，使她走得更快。

“That’ll be a no to tea, then?” came Draco’s drawl from behind them.
“那不喝茶吧吧？”

“We’ll have tea when we’re out,” Hermione called happily, catching Lucius’ eye over her shoulder and grinning. “We can.”
“我们出去的时候喝茶，”赫敏高兴地喊道，对上卢修斯的眼睛，她咧嘴一笑。“我们可以。”

"No one could accuse you of wasting time,” Lucius said, his voice low as he allowed her to drag him out of the dining room and into the hallway. “We’re going right now?”
“没人能指责你浪费时间，”卢修斯说，他压低了声音，让她把他拖出餐厅，走进走廊。“我们现在就去？”

“Maybe I want to show you off.”
“也许我想炫耀你。”

赫敏没有看到他的脸，他把手从她的手上抽出来，停在餐厅外面的大厅里，但当她转过身来时，她发现他的嘴唇很薄，姿势很紧张。“别嘲笑我，”它说，仿佛她在这种时候会这样。

They eyed one another in the narrow hallway, Lucius in the open doorway, Hermione across from him near the wall. Lips pursed thoughtfully, Hermione reached around to her back pocket and slid her wand out of her jeans. As she brought it round to her front, Lucius’ eyes darted down to it and stopped, seemingly arrested by the sight of it. Taking a couple of steps forward, Hermione turned the wand so that its handle was directed to Lucius, while its end pointed straight at her middle. 
他们在狭窄的走廊里互相看着，卢修斯在敞开的门口，赫敏在他对面的墙壁附近。赫敏若有所思地抿起嘴唇，把手伸到她的后兜里，把魔杖从牛仔裤里滑了出来。当她把它带到面前时，卢修斯的眼睛瞪着它，然后停了下来，似乎被它的景象吓住了。赫敏向前走了几步，转动魔杖，使魔杖的手柄对准卢修斯，而魔杖的末端则直接指向她的中间。

“Here,” she said, her voice little more than a whisper. “Why don’t you hold it?”
“在这里，”她说，她的声音只不过是耳语。“你为什么不拿着它？”

Lucius’ eyes remained fixed on her wand, his body completely still apart from the fingers of his right hand which twitched reflexively. He hadn’t held a wand since that day in the greenhouse. He had once tried to explain how it had felt to her. ‘Exquisitely painful’ he had said. Unbearable and thrilling.
卢修斯的眼睛一直盯着她的魔杖，他的身体完全静止不动，除了他反射性地抽搐的右手手指。自从那天在温室里以来，他就再也没有拿过魔杖。他曾经试图解释她当时的感受。“非常痛苦，”他说。难以忍受和惊心动魄。

When he didn’t reach out, the memory of the pain perhaps making him hesitate, Hermione lifted it a little higher, encouraging him. “We share a core, don’t we? she asked, her voice encouraging. “It won’t be exactly like holding a wand just for you but it might be nice to have this moment privately. In case it’s…overwhelming.”
当他没有伸出手时，痛苦的记忆或许让他犹豫不决，赫敏把它抬高了一点，鼓励他。“我们有一个共同的核心，不是吗？她问道，她的声音带着鼓励。“这不会完全像只为你拿着一根魔杖，但私下里拥有这一刻可能会很好。万一是......压倒性的。

Eyes travelling up her arm to her face, Lucius slowly nodded and, in the next moment, he closed his fingers around the handle of her wand. Hermione drew her own hand away just as Lucius’ eyes fell closed and a choked gasp escaped him. His hand tightened around the carved wood, trembling as his magic responded to the contact. 
眼睛顺着她的手臂滑向她的脸，卢修斯缓缓地点了点头，下一刻，他用手指握住了她的魔杖手柄。赫敏把自己的手抽开了，这时卢修斯闭上了眼睛，哽咽的喘息声从他身上逸出。他的手紧紧地握住了雕刻的木头，随着他的魔法对接触的反应而颤抖。

Watching him made her heart swell, recalling the warm rush and the sense of connection and rightness when she’d finally held a wand that accepted her. It had been like her magic had found its gateway into the world.
看着他让她的心膨胀，回想起当她终于握住一根接受她的魔杖时的温暖冲动以及联系和正确的感觉。就好像她的魔法找到了通往世界的门户。

Lucius took in a deep, sharp breath and Hermione took a half-step forward, her hands coming up in case he needed support. “Is it – are you – is it okay?”
卢修斯深吸了一口气，赫敏向前走了半步，她的手举起来，以防他需要支持。“是吗——你是——还好吗？”

“It feels…” His exhale was low, shuddering, as his eyes fluttered open to observe the wand in his hand with wonder. His throat bobbed as he swallowed hard and his eyes flicked up to her concerned face. “I think I feel you,” he said hoarsely. “Your magic.”
“感觉......”他低沉地呼出一口气，颤抖着，双眼颤抖着睁开，惊奇地观察着他手中的魔杖。他的喉咙在他用力吞咽时晃动着，他的眼睛眨向她关切的脸。“我想我能感觉到你，”他嘶哑地说。“你的魔法。”

“What does it –” Hermione reached up and tucked a curl behind her ear, suddenly self-conscious. “What do I feel like?”
“什么——”赫敏伸手把一缕卷发塞到耳后，突然变得不自在。“我感觉如何？”

Rather than answer her, Lucius lowered the hand holding her wand and closed the space between them in two steps. Hermione’s back met the wall of the hallway with a faint thump  and he stopped, his body just brushing against hers. 
卢修斯没有回答她，而是放下了握着魔杖的手，分两步拉近了他们之间的距离。赫敏的背撞在走廊的墙壁上，发出微弱的砰砰声，他停了下来，他的身体只是擦过她的身体。

赫敏伸长了脖子，她的目光从他的衬衫领子上移开，顺着他的脖子，一直到他的眼睛，她发现一种饥饿让她很难把视线移开。卢修斯慢慢地看着她的眼睛，伸出一只手捧住她的脸，进一步抬起她的下巴。赫敏被这件事分散了注意力，她畏缩了一下，感到惊讶，这时，她感觉到卢修斯的另一只手碰到了她的手。

Encouraging her to open her fingers, he pressed the carved wood of her wand – almost as warm as his skin – against her palm. Pushing her knuckles and wrist against the wall, he linked their fingers together so that the wand was sandwiched between them.
他鼓励她张开手指，将她魔杖的雕刻木头——几乎和他的皮肤一样温暖——压在她的手掌上。他把她的指关节和手腕靠在墙上，把他们的手指连在一起，这样魔杖就夹在他们之间。

Quite suddenly, she thought she could feel it. His magic. Friendly and familiar yet somehow also strange, channeling through her wand to just graze around the edges of her own magic. She wanted more of it. 
突然间，她觉得自己能感觉到。他的魔法。友好而熟悉，但不知何故也奇怪，通过她的魔杖引导，只是在她自己的魔法边缘掠过。她想要更多。

Sliding the fingers of her free hand between the buttons of his waistcoat, Hermione pulled Lucius down, bringing their lips together in a passionate kiss. His hips pressed forward against hers and she drew in a sharp gasp as her wand thrummed gently.
赫敏用她空出来的手的手指在他背心的纽扣之间滑动，把卢修斯拉下来，把他们的嘴唇靠在一起，热情地吻了起来。他的臀部向前压在她的臀部上，她的魔杖轻轻地嗡嗡作响，她发出尖锐的喘息。

“While we’re at Diagon Alley,” she whispered urgently, her breath feathering over his face, “why don’t we take a trip to Gringotts?” 
“趁我们在对角巷的时候，”她急切地低声说，她的呼吸在他的脸上飞快，“我们为什么不去古灵阁一趟呢？

Keeping her against the wall, Lucius pulled his head back slightly, frowning down at her. 
卢修斯把她靠在墙上，把头微微向后仰，皱着眉头看着她。

“I seem to remember you wanted to show me some of the Malfoy family jewels,” she explained with a meaningful tilt of her head. Dawning realisation smoothed Lucius’ brow and a smirk quirked at the corner of his mouth. “The rubies in particular.”
“我好像记得你想给我看一些马尔福家族的珠宝，”她意味深长地歪着头解释道。恍然大悟使卢修斯的眉头变得柔和，他的嘴角弯起一丝得意的笑容。“尤其是红宝石。”

“I did,” he murmured, dipping his head to kiss just under her ear, nipping at it with his teeth in a way that made her squirm.
“我记得，”他喃喃自语，低下头亲吻她的耳下，用牙齿咬着它，让她蠕动起来。

“And you mentioned something about using a string of pearls in a variety of ways,” she said, her grip on his waistcoat tightening to the degree that she was sure she was at risk of ripping a button. “I’m sure you could make Dumbeldore’s findings around the twelve uses of Dragon’s Blood look like nothing.”
“你还提到了以各种方式使用一串珍珠的事情，”她说，她抓着他的背心的手越来越紧，以至于她确信自己有扯掉纽扣的风险。“我敢肯定，你可以让邓贝尔多关于龙血的十二种用途的发现看起来毫无意义。”

“Flattery, Hermione,” Lucius murmured into her neck, an almost disapproving edge to his words. “Really?”
“奉承，赫敏，”卢修斯对着她的脖子喃喃自语，他的话几乎带着不赞成的语气。“真的吗？”

“I’d say I’m more…” She tilted her neck for him, exposing her rapidly pulsing jugular to his searching lips. “Issuing a challenge. You like those.”
“我想说我更......”她向他倾斜脖子，将她快速跳动的颈静脉暴露在他寻找的嘴唇上。“发出挑战。你喜欢这些。

At that Lucius straightened up, looking down at her with an eyebrow just slightly raised. Pushing her wand more firmly against her palm, he withdrew his own hand, forcing Hermione to close her fingers completely around the wood to stop it falling. 
听到这话，卢修斯直起身来，微微扬起眉毛看着她。他把魔杖更用力地推向她的手掌，收回了自己的手，迫使赫敏用手指完全合拢木头，以防止它掉下来。

“Don’t think I don’t know what you’re doing,” he said.
“别以为我不知道你在干什么，”他说。

“What would that be?” she asked, her flushed cheeks and breathlessness somewhat ruining her attempt at innocence.
“那会是什么？” 她问道，她通红的脸颊和喘不过气来在某种程度上破坏了她对纯真的尝试。

“Trying to manipulate me,” he said, his face leaning towards hers again. “Into leaving the manor.” Slightly narrowed, his eyes flicked between hers, searching. “I’m letting you do it.” 
“试图操纵我，”他说，他的脸再次向她的脸倾斜。“离开庄园。”他微微眯起眼睛，在她的眼睛之间扫视，寻找着。“我让你来做。”

“It’s not like that,” Hermione said earnestly, shaking her head. “I’ll never make you do something if you really don’t want to do it, Lucius. I promise.”
“不是那样的，”赫敏认真地说，摇了摇头。“如果你真的不想做某事，我永远不会让你做某事，卢修斯。我保证。

A half-smile playing about his lips, Lucius tucked a curl that had come loose back behind her ear, the backs of fingers caressing her cheek. As he did so, he caught sight of the scar of his Dark Mark peeking out from beneath his rolled shirt sleeve and his smile faltered.
卢修斯的嘴唇上浮现出半笑半笑，将一头松散的卷发塞到耳后，指背抚摸着她的脸颊。当他这样做时，他看到他的黑暗标记的疤痕从他卷起的衬衫袖子下面探出头来，他的笑容变得蹒跚。

"What's wrong?" she asked, her eyes following his.
“怎么了？” 她问道，她的眼睛跟着他。

“I’m not sure I believe in fresh starts or new beginnings, Hermione,” he murmured, eyes fixed on his Dark Mark. “And I’m not sure that even those who do believe in them really see them as something for others.” 
“我不确定我是否相信新的开始或新的开始，赫敏，”他喃喃自语，眼睛盯着他的黑暗标记。“我不确定即使是那些相信它们的人是否真的将它们视为他人的东西。”

Brow furrowing, Hermione tugged at his waistcoat in an attempt to convince him to look at her again. “Lucius...look, this isn’t really about starting or beginning or cleaning slates. It’s just…” She shrugged helplessly. “The next part.” 
赫敏皱着眉头，拉扯着他的背心，试图说服他再看她一眼。“卢修斯......看，这并不是真的关于开始、开始或清理石板。只是......”她无奈地耸了耸肩。“下一部分。”

Relinquishing his waistcoat, Hermione wrapped her hand around Lucius’ forearm so that the tips of her fingers overlapped the faded outline of the skull that had once been so stark against his skin. “I mean, you took this mark but you’re not really the same as you were then, are you?”
赫敏放下背心，用手搂住卢修斯的前臂，让她的指尖与曾经在他的皮肤上如此鲜明的头骨褪色的轮廓重叠。“我的意思是，你拿了这个标记，但你和当时的你真的不一样了，对吧？”

He frowned, seemingly entranced by her touch. “I suppose not, no.” Hermione held back a scoff — as far as she was concerned, that was an understatement.
他皱起眉头，似乎被她的触碰迷住了。“我想没有，没有。”赫敏忍住了嘲笑——就她而言，那只是轻描淡写。

“I don’t think you should forget who you were but it’d be foolish to let him hold you back or dictate who you will be.” Turning her cheek into his palm, she pressed a kiss onto it. “That’s up to you right now.”
“我认为你不应该忘记你是谁，但让他拖你后腿或决定你将成为什么样的人是愚蠢的。”她把脸颊贴在他的手掌上，在上面亲了一下。“现在就看你了。”

Finally tearing his gaze from her hold on his arm, Lucius looked into her face. His expression was unreadable but his eyes flicked over every line, curve and freckle, inspecting, searching. 
终于，卢修斯将目光从她抓住他的手臂上移开，看着她的脸。他的表情难以捉摸，但他的眼睛扫视着每一行、曲线和雀斑，检查着，搜索着。

Then, quite suddenly, Lucius stepped back, tugging his arm out of Hermione’s grasp. Before she could protest, he extended his hand out across the gap he’d made between them, his palm open in an invitation. “Let’s go, then.”
然后，突然间，卢修斯向后退了一步，把他的手臂从赫敏的手中拽了出来。在她能够抗议之前，他伸出手划过他之间的缝隙，张开手掌发出邀请。“那么，我们走吧。”

Lumione readers are lovely and so so encouraging and I can't thank you all enough for making writing this fic so much fun. 
感谢你把这个小说读到最后 <3 我简直不敢相信它收到了如此积极的回应，尤其是因为它几乎只是我找到将两个白痴推到一起的方法的几十万字。Lumione 的读者很可爱，非常鼓舞人心，我非常感谢你们让写这个小说变得如此有趣。

I have something tumbling around in my mind for a future fic and although I won't make any promises, I'd love to think I'll be back in 2023. In the meantime, I'm finally going to go back to reading and enjoying some other fics for a while!
我脑海中有一些关于未来 fic 的事情，虽然我不会做出任何承诺，但我很想想象我会在 2023 年回来。与此同时，我终于要回去阅读和享受一段时间的其他小说了！
